title: api-contract-design-skill Input
description: Input contract for producing the OpenAPI 3.1 API_Contract.json

architecture_path.description: Path to completed Architecture.md. Must be post-Gate 2 draft or revision.

existing_contract_path.description: Optional path to an existing API_Contract.json being revised. If provided, the skill diffs and updates rather than creating from scratch.

auth_scheme.description: Primary authentication scheme. Defaults to BearerAuth (NextAuth v5 JWT). Use ApiKey for machine-to-machine endpoints only.

endpoints_to_skip.description: List of endpoint paths intentionally excluded from this contract (e.g., third-party webhooks handled externally). Requires justification in Architecture.md.
